title: Parents' Portal for Monitoring Students' Academic Performance and More
excerpt: During the first years (2026) parents' engagement forum, parents were sensitised on University policies and processes and the use of the Parents and Guardians Portal to monitor their students' academic progress and performance.
content:
During the session (first years {2026} parents' engagement forum), parents were sensitised on the [Dedan Kimathi University of Technology](https://www.dkut.ac.ke/) policies and processes and the use of the Parents and Guardians Portal to monitor their students' academic progress and performance.

The forum brought together parents and guardians of first-year students from the 2026 intake, giving them an opportunity to interact directly with university administration and understand how to support their students remotely through digital tools provided by [DeKUT](https://www.dkut.ac.ke/).

## Parents and Guardians Portal

The university's Parents and Guardians Portal is a dedicated online platform that enables parents to:

- Track their student's academic performance and results in real time
- Receive updates on fee balances and payment status
- Monitor attendance and engagement records
- Access official university notices and communication

> "We want parents to be partners in the education of our students, not passive observers," noted a senior university administrator during the session.

## University Policies and Processes

Parents were walked through key [Dedan Kimathi University of Technology](https://www.dkut.ac.ke/) policies including:

- Academic progression and examination regulations
- Student welfare and counselling services available on campus
- The university's code of conduct and disciplinary procedures
- How to escalate concerns through official channels

The engagement forum is part of [DeKUT](https://www.dkut.ac.ke/)'s ongoing commitment to maintaining open communication with families and fostering a supportive academic environment for all students.
